items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution via Improper Output Encoding in Webhooks
items.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) in Adobe Commerce's webhooks component allows unauthenticated, zero-interaction arbitrary code execution due to improper output encoding.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of Dangerous File Type
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) allows attackers to upload malicious files to the server, potentially leading to further compromise.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A stored XSS flaw enables privilege escalation by injecting scripts into the admin backend, which execute when an administrator views the poisoned record.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Flaws
items.summary: These vulnerabilities involve incorrect authorization, with one circumventing default system rules and the other granting unauthorized access to resources.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical (CVSS 9.8) unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Denial-of-Service Vulnerability via Third-Party Component
items.summary: This critical denial-of-service vulnerability in Adobe Commerce stems from a vulnerable third-party component and can be triggered remotely without authentication, causing application crashes.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Unauthorized Write Access
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization flaw (CWE-863) in Adobe Commerce allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw, named PolyShell, in Magento's REST API that enables unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities leading to Security Feature Bypass, Privilege Escalation, and Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security mechanisms, gain escalated privileges, and execute unauthorized malicious code.
